picks.annotation: Consistent 15% of your damage by end game. Obviously does more damage to higher health targets so prioritize them if just looking for heals. You need 165 Scorn damage to proc this.

picks.name: Knockdown
picks.annotation: Buy into ults you need to stun but can't get close enough to Cursed Relic them.

picks.name: Quicksilver Reload
picks.annotation: Even more healing and damage just like Mystic Burst. The second you get this you can start making aggressive health trades.

picks.name: Counterspell
picks.annotation: Great item in theory, but it takes a lot of practice to be good at. Perfect counter to Lash/Pocket/Calico and just about anyone with a delayed acting ability. Doesn't work in Burrow.
